steps.action: Build two bread slices by stacking two 1x4 tan bricks and topping each with two slopes facing outward at the ends, then push the toaster lever so the brown toast pops up and set the new slices beside the toaster.
watch_for: Place the two slopes on the end studs with their sloped sides facing away from each other, leaving the middle studs exposed
Align the two stacked 1x4 bricks evenly with no overhang
